lede: Wat Huai Khrai Luang accounts for 40 catalogued manuscripts, 16 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (68%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (32%). Dated witnesses run 1895–1989 CE (18 of 40 carry a date).
